root_idea.summary: The root centers on going before or being foremost, with related branches involving precedence, forward movement, arrival, antiquity, and things located at the front.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of moving ahead or not turning back, the root develops meanings of temporal or positional precedence, advancement and leadership, prior action or provision, oldness, the foot as an instrument of advance, and front or foremost parts. The adze is recorded as an exceptional lexical branch.

senses.definition: To go before or precede; to lead by being at the head.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in relation to a people or other group, and for proceeding ahead.

senses.definition: To send, put, or bring forward; to do or lay up beforehand.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of deeds, acts, or other things sent ahead so that their consequences or record precede the speaker or agent.

senses.definition: To put someone or something before another; to give precedence or put oneself forward.
senses.usage_conditions: The precedence may be temporal, spatial, or relational, including the construction of putting oneself forward before another authority.

senses.definition: To present or offer something to someone.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with an offered object or provision, including an act of presenting an offering.

senses.definition: To prepare or provide something beforehand.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for preparing something in advance for a later event or purpose.

senses.definition: To warn or inform someone beforehand.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional construction is قَدَّمَ إِلَيْهِ بِكَذَا, informing or warning someone before the time of need.

senses.definition: To go before, precede, or advance.
senses.usage_conditions: The precedence may be in time, position, rank, or movement forward; the form can also describe what has already preceded.

senses.definition: To go before or advance ahead.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in contrast with delay or lagging behind, especially in statements denying the ability to advance or precede an appointed time.

senses.definition: The earlier or ancient ones; predecessors or forefathers.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic plural form referring to those who came before.

senses.definition: One who goes before, precedes, or comes first.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural denotes those preceding or arriving before others.
The ordinary anatomical noun, with plural أَقْدَامٌ.

senses.definition: A prior mark of merit or an established position of honor.
senses.usage_conditions: In the expression قَدَمُ صِدْقٍ, it denotes a preceding or previously established excellence with God.

senses.definition: Old or ancient; belonging to an earlier time.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of something whose existence or age extends into the past; the Quranic uses do not by themselves assert existence without beginning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come to or arrive at a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a place or destination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To advance boldly upon an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with عَلَى expresses bold or energetic undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring someone or something near, or cause it to approach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively with a destination or object of approach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring or bring forward someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the general transitive bringing-forward use, distinct from the more specific senses of presenting or laying up beforehand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pay a price in advance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a payment made before it is due.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prefer one course of action over another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with an action expresses choosing or favoring it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To urge someone forward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used causatively of prompting a person or animal to advance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be bold or audacious; to venture upon something courageously.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used with عَلَى for undertaking an affair or confronting an adversary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw near or approach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a destination or object toward which one moves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become advanced or promoted in rank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to advancement in status rather than merely preceding in time or place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For speech or a statement to proceed from someone beforehand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of words or speech that have proceeded previously from a speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be forward in an affair before undertaking it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes acting or positioning oneself ahead of the subsequent action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To command, order, charge, or enjoin someone regarding an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction تَقَدَّمَ إِلَيْهِ فِي كَذَا or بِكَذَا conveys an injunction or command.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become old.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes something as becoming old or having aged.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow someone’s example or take someone as an exemplar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction بِهِ marks the person whose conduct is imitated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A footing, firm foundation, or established basis; by extension, a settled standing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively in expressions of firmness, excellence, or an established foundation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A successor or one who takes another’s place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression عَلَى قَدَمِ فُلَانٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Oldness or antiquity; existence or duration without a beginning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The abstract noun may refer either to ordinary antiquity or, in theological usage, to beginningless existence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The front or foremost position.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially in the expression مِنْ قُدُمٍ, meaning in front.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An adze or hewing tool used by a carpenter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An exceptional technical meaning not derived from the ordinary semantic branch of precedence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An established reputation or ancestral standing of a person or people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative use referring to inherited renown or standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Ancient without beginning, as a divine epithet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A theological epithet in Classical usage; this sense is not asserted by the Quranic adjective occurrences in this packet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place or location that is before.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of frontward location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The foremost feathers of a bird’s wing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical or ornithological plural.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Boldness, daring, or courageous advance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression جَرِيءُ المُقْدَمِ for one bold in undertaking action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A very bold, daring, or courageous person, especially against an enemy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fronts, foreparts, or the front of the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural noun for foremost bodily or spatial parts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chief, head, director, conductor, or manager.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized passive-participial noun for one placed at the head of others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The antecedent or first proposition in an argument or hypothetical proposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical logical term for what is put first in a proposition or enthymeme.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The van or vanguard of an army.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective military term for the part placed at the front.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A premise, proposition, or basis on which an inquiry, proof, or syllogism rests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term in reasoning and demonstration, including an implicit premise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Preceding, anterior, or situated in advance of others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used figuratively of someone forward or advanced in affairs.

أَقْدَمُون is retained as a Quran-attested plural/substantivized form because the packet does not supply a dedicated singular lexicographic entry for that form.
The Lane citation in the Form II discussion using historical citation notation is not converted into an additional modern Quran location.
